mcq.q: Laravel mein sab requests kis file se shuru hoti hain?
mcq.why: Web server har request `public/index.php` ko deta hai.

mcq.q: Interface ko concrete class se kahan bind karte hain?
mcq.why: Bindings service provider ke `register()` method mein hote hain.

mcq.q: Laravel 11+ mein providers ki list kahan hoti hai?
mcq.why: User-defined providers `bootstrap/providers.php` mein listed hote hain.

mcq.q: Custom facade mein kaunsa method zaroori hai?
mcq.why: `getFacadeAccessor()` batata hai ki container se kya resolve karna hai.

mcq.q: Service providers ka order kya hai?
options: Ek provider ka dono, phir agla
mcq.why: Pehle sab providers ka `register`, uske baad sab ka `boot`.

mcq.q: MVC mein Controller ka kaam kya hai?
options: Request lena aur model/view ke beech coordinate karna
mcq.why: Controller request handle karke model/service se kaam karwata hai aur response deta hai.

assignments.title: Interface binding
assignments.brief: Container se interface ko implementation se bind karo.
tasks: `LogSender` class banao jo `logger()` se message likhe
`AppServiceProvider::register()` mein interface ko `LogSender` se bind karo
Ek controller ke constructor mein `SmsSender` inject karke use karo
assignments.explain: Controller sirf interface jaanta hai, isliye implementation badalna aasan hai.

solution.code:
<?php

namespace App\Contracts;

interface SmsSender
{
    public function send(string $to, string $text): bool;
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Contracts\SmsSender;

class LogSender implements SmsSender
{
    public function send(string $to, string $text): bool
    {
        logger("SMS to {$to}: {$text}");

        return true;
    }
}

assignments.title: Lifecycle trace middleware
assignments.brief: Middleware se request lifecycle ka order dekho.
tasks: `handle()` mein request aate aur response jaate waqt `logger()` se message likho
Log file mein order dekho: middleware, route, middleware
assignments.explain: `$next($request)` se pehle ka code request par, baad ka code response par chalta hai.

interview.a: `public/index.php` -> autoloader -> `bootstrap/app.php` -> HTTP kernel -> bootstrappers aur service providers -> middleware -> router -> controller -> response -> middleware se wapas -> response send.
Laravel ka dependency management tool jo classes resolve karta hai aur unki dependencies inject karta hai.

interview.q: What is the difference between register() and boot()?
interview.a: `register()` sirf container bindings ke liye. `boot()` sab providers register hone ke baad chalta hai aur kisi bhi service ko use kar sakta hai.
Container mein registered service ka static-jaisa proxy. Static call andar se container ke object ka method chalati hai.
`Illuminate\Contracts` ke interfaces jo framework services ka contract batate hain, DI mein type-hint ke liye use hote hain.

interview.q: What is the fat controller problem?
interview.a: Controller mein bahut logic bhar jaane se testing aur reuse mushkil hota hai. Logic ko model ya service/action classes mein rakhna chahiye.
